 Nov 14, 2026, 9:27 PM ET 
Charlotte Hornets forward Brandon Miller (hip) is off the injury report ahead of Sunday's game against the Los Angeles Clippers after missing the previous two contests. Miller exited the Nov. 6 loss to Boston with what was initially called right groin soreness before later being listed with a right hip strain. The 23-year-old is averaging 20.6 points, 5.0 rebounds, and 1.1 steals, though his 35.6 percent shooting remains a concern. With Kon Knueppel (hamstring) still sidelined, Miller should step right back into a prominent offensive role. Sion James is the likeliest candidate to return to the bench, while Miller's return should also absorb some of the usage that opened up for Grayson Allen and Naz Reid . -- Brian Dailisan

 Nov 17, 2026, 10:30 PM ET 
Miami Heat forward/center Bam Adebayo (hip) is probable for Wednesday's matchup with the Milwaukee Bucks due to a right hip impingement.
